meta.name: anndata
meta.description: Data structure for annotated matrices in single-cell analysis. Use when working with .h5ad files or integrating with the scverse ecosystem. This is the data format skill—for analysis workflows use scanpy; for probabilistic models use scvi-tools; for population-scale queries use cellxgene-census.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 读入并组织单细胞测序产生的注释矩阵,为下游分析打好基础。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果处理单细胞测序结果,需要按注释矩阵整理基因表达数据。
copy.tagline_en: Read and organize annotated single-cell matrices for downstream analysis.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you handle single-cell sequencing data and need a standard way to organize annotated expression matrices.

howto.what: 让 Claude 直接创建、读写和操作带注释的矩阵数据(AnnData 对象),覆盖 .h5ad、zarr 等格式,能做合并、筛选、转置、稀疏矩阵和 backed 模式等操作。它只管数据格式,分析流程要用 scanpy。
howto.when: 当你处理 .h5ad 或 zarr 文件、合并多批数据集,或要与 scverse 生态工具配合时接管。

howto.what_en: Lets Claude create, read, write and manipulate annotated matrices (AnnData objects) in .h5ad, zarr and other formats — concatenating datasets, subsetting, transposing, sparse and backed mode. Format only; analysis runs via scanpy.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you work with .h5ad or zarr files, concatenate batches, or integrate with scverse ecosystem tools.
